scenarios.eyebrow: Find the effort that does not become delivery
scenarios.title: Where is your operation losing time, money and capacity?
scenarios.description: A growing queue, repeated tasks and scattered information have the same effect: more effort to deliver. Explore eight situations and see how to connect management, AI and processes to address waste.

items.pain: “We only find the problem after the queue has grown.”
items.title: See where work is building up.
items.description: Bring together demand, queues and the work handled by AI and people. Distinguish today's activity from work that is still active, including earlier days, to locate the bottleneck and decide where to act.

steps.title: Observe
steps.text: Today's demand and work still active.

steps.title: Locate
steps.text: Queues, longest wait and handoffs to people.

steps.title: Prioritize
steps.text: The team and cases that need attention.

benefits: See what AI received, resolved or handed over and what reached the team, respecting each indicator's definition.
Check queue health and the longest wait to investigate the backlog before choosing an intervention.
items.metric: Active work, waiting conversations, longest wait and volume by team within the selected scope.

example.title: From total volume to a point of attention

example.then: It compares AI and human views and checks queue health to locate the team with waiting work.

Balance incoming demand with per-operator limits and options for waiting or routing to another team.
items.metric: Workload per operator, waiting conversations and distribution of work across people and teams.

faq.title: Clarity to organize. Evidence to improve.

items.question: Is artificial intelligence for operations limited to customer service?
items.answer: The platform connects conversations, tickets, owners, queues, AI and systems to organize work linked to the customer journey. The assessment identifies where to apply process automation and which stages to track in yapt. or integrated systems.

items.question: How can we balance the team’s workload?
items.answer: Combine views of queues, current workload, limits and operator availability to decide where to support the operation. Configure manual routing or automatic round-robin or least-loaded routing, priorities and options for waiting or a backup team. Capacity should be read alongside workload and limits, as well as online status.

items.question: What can we automate with AI?
items.answer: We can combine flows, sequences and agents to look up information, prepare responses, update records and route demand according to defined triggers and conditions. Each scenario uses configured knowledge, tools and permissions, with human review or continuation when needed. For mentor suggestions, the operator decides what to apply.

items.question: How are time targets tracked after an AI response?
items.answer: An automatic reply, assignment and first human response are different events. Each team configures targets and enables time controls relevant to its process, including response and resolution times. Assigning a conversation does not mean responding to the customer.

items.question: Do we need to replace our systems?
items.answer: The assessment defines what to bring into yapt. and what to connect. In yaAgents, we build connections through conversation to make data, lookups and actions available in the work. Feasibility depends on available systems, APIs, access and tools.

items.question: How do we evaluate productivity and the return on a change?
items.answer: We define the scenario, period and comparable criteria to track waiting time, workload, volume, times and productivity. The analysis considers cases and working conditions to guide the next adjustments. To evaluate economic impact, we combine operational indicators with business costs and data.

items.question: Where do we start and how do specialists participate?
items.answer: You can start with a concrete problem, such as a queue backlog or repeated manual lookups. Specialists are available to help configure the first scenario, test it with the team and analyze indicators. Their involvement and scope are defined according to your operational needs.
